text: Three little pigs set off to build their own cozy homes.
One made a straw house, another made a stick house, and the third took time to build a sturdy brick house.
A big bad wolf came along, huffed and puffed, and blew the straw house down.
He huffed and puffed again, and the stick house tumbled too.
The pigs hurried to the brick house and felt safe behind its strong red walls.
The wolf huffed and puffed, but the brick house held firm, so he gave up and the pigs cheered and learned that careful work makes a happy home.
